summary: Flat parked-up residential kerb, but homes sit 11-19 m away on both sides.
reasons: Cars park along the whole street

drivers.seclusion: Inverona apartments 13 m behind the east kerb at 72 m, a carport at 14 m and units about 11 m away from 107 m; west-side homes 19 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed two-way street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van where gaps exist.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential through street between two cross streets.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked on both sides, so a van would blend in.

flags: Homes 10-25 m away on both sides
Max grade 10.4% elsewhere on the line, but 85-100 m is about 1%
sun_shade: Open at the best section with some tree shade from the south-east; light afternoon shade from west-side trees.

best_section.where: Mid-block on Lucinda Street, between the Inverona apartments and the low units further south
